Effective / last updated: September 21, 2026

Welcome to the legal hub for Fernandes Journeys. The long policies now live on their own pages so you can find what you need without scrolling a wall of text. Everything is written for a personal travel journal — clear, not scary.

Operator: Alex Fernandes · contact@fernandesjourneys.com

  • Privacy Policy — who we are, accounts, cookies, Turnstile, Resend & Mailchimp, forwarded booking emails, third parties, kids, rights, retention.
  • Terms of Use — personal use, no agency, warranties, liability, acceptable use, accounts.
  • Affiliate & monetization disclosure — commissions, partners, /tools, FTC notes.

Old bookmarks that pointed at anchors on this page still work: #privacy → Privacy, #terms → Terms, #monetization → Affiliate disclosure.

Google Sign-In purpose (for OAuth branding): see About this site & Google Sign-In.
